title: Horizon and Gravity
author: Hazel Voss
blurb: Xanthe Ashgrove, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
